definition: High-dM: SR/CR in the same category and U_T bin. Low-dM: SR GNN score bin / mapped GNN CR parent integral. The raw Zinv/GJ coefficient does not yet contain RZ or Sgamma.

definition.TF: SR category GNN bin / mapped CR parent target-process integral; CR score fractions retained
definition.double_ratio_nuisances: not inserted here; pass separate measured downstream_central_abs_deviation to main agent
definition.shape_only: Sgamma is normalized in GCR; no additional Z-integral renormalization introduced
definition.shared_CR_denominator_covariance: TF bins with the same process and CR parent share denominator variance; exported parent totals define cross-category covariance
definition.zinv: RZ(Nb) * sum_ut(H_Zinv(GNN,ut) * Sgamma(Nb,ut)); Q is not transferred

category_policy.highdm: Nb=1 and Nb>=2 in native U_T bins
category_policy.lowdm: Frozen GNN30 final templates; Nb=1/Nb>=2 factor groups only; UT diagnostics are not templates

provenance.lowdm_mode: GNN30 final templates only; no UT or legacy-search-bin fallback

uncertainty: numerator and denominator MC statistical uncertainties propagated in quadrature
